# DPA · SDT — Self Declared Token | Decentralized Partnership Agreement
> Document partnership agreements between crypto wallet holders, link wallets to self-declared passport details, and record participation shares

## About
A partnership workspace connecting wallet-linked declarations, off-chain terms, individual acceptances and participation shares. Includes historical declaration comparison and downloadable evidence reports.
